name: Slack
title: Slack: Rouh's own app in your workspace, listening, reading back and answering

permissions: reads every message in the Slack channels Rouh's bot is in, in direct messages to it, and in the person's own direct messages with their read-only user token
posts in Slack as Rouh's bot, never as the person: an answer to a message to Rouh, through the one outbox for a case, and slack_send only on the person's yes

reads every kept message for promises made by the person or to them, with a model, a conversation a call (rouh/slack_promises.py): the person's own become Clockwork reminders a day before they are due (cancelled when a later message shows them kept), and one made to them is a decision only once it is late, whose Chase posts a nudge as Rouh's bot only on the person's yes
joins a public channel itself only on the person's word

answers people the owner set up as trusted contacts from what they - and in a channel everybody in it - may see of the owner's meetings, tasks and files (rouh/slack_team.py); anybody else gets one polite answer and the owner one notice per person

writes each decision made in a Slack channel the person linked to a task into that task's notes (its AGENTS.md, under Decided in Slack), with a link to the message, never from a direct message (rouh/slack_tasks.py)
jobs: the Socket Mode listener and its 90-day read back (rouh/slack_listen.py), started with Rouh
Slack conversations into Synapse Master, one item a day, in the ten-minute sync (synapse/master.py sync_slack)

before a meeting, what the owner and each guest last said in Slack, read from the kept messages by one model call under the meeting brief's pick (rouh/meeting_slack.py), on the brief and in meeting_people's answer
reading kept messages for promises once Slack is quiet, and every ten minutes (slack_listen.Listener._promise_reader)
reading the channels linked to tasks for decisions, at the same quiet moment as the promises (slack_tasks.sweep from slack_listen.Listener._promise_reader)
touches.remove: the Anatomy section in rouh/templates/rouh/index.html, slackpage.js/.css, rouh/slack.py, rouh/slack_listen.py, rouh/web/slack.py and its routes, the slack_* tools in rouh/tools.py, the SLACK prompt in rouh/brain.py, the slack channel in mail_outbox/mail_cases/trusted, sync_slack in synapse/master.py, the slack source in rouh/silos.py, rouh/slack_team.py, find_for_them in rouh/tools.py and mail_turn.py, Trusted.within, rouh/testing/fake_slack.py, rouh/meeting_slack.py with its calls in meeting_brief.make and tools._meeting_people, slackDraw in briefpage.js and its CSS, the meeting_slack stand-in in fake_model.py, rouh/slack_promises.py with PromiseSource in rouh/decision_sources.py, the slack_promises use in rouh/modeldefaults.py and its stand-in in fake_model.py, the Clockwork reminders it made (reminders rows whose ids are in slack_promises.clockwork_id), rouh/slack_tasks.py with its sweep in slack_listen.py, the slack_link tool, _slack_section and the slack_* actions in rouh/objectindex.py, the Slack part of taskpage.js and its CSS in taskbrowser.css, the slack_decisions use in rouh/modeldefaults.py and its stand-in in fake_model.py, and this manifest; drop the seven slack_* tables with a migration.
